findings.source_quote: As they neared the end of their seven-mile walk and approached the village where they were going, Jesus …made as though he would have gone further. But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them –Luke 24:28-29.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the mistranslated distance so it matches the English meaning. Preserve the rest of the sentence and the verse reference. For example: «Da de nærmet seg slutten av sin syv miles lange vandring og kom nær landsbyen de var på vei til, … –Lukas 24:28-29.» (Use ‘miles’ rendered as ‘miles’ or ‘miles’ in Norwegian spelling ‘miles’ or an explicit ‘mile/miles’—but do NOT render it as ‘mil’ which in Norwegian denotes 10 km.)
findings.translation_quote: Da de nærmet seg slutten av sin sju mil lange vandring og kom nær landsbyen de var på vei til, … –Lukas 24:28-29.

findings.location:
...Selv om han var sterkt svekket...grepet av et «ureistentlig ønske»...

(paragraph about preaching Sept 4, 1847)
findings.source_quote: Though he was greatly weakened by his sickness, on September 4, 1847, as Lyte was about to leave to head southward, he was arrested by an “irresistible desire” to preach once more to his congregation.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the typographical error in the Norwegian rendering of “irresistible”. Use a standard Norwegian rendering such as «urestoppelig lyst», «et uimotståelig ønske» or «et uimotståelig begjær», preserving the quotation marks. For example: «...ble Lyte 4. september 1847, da han var i ferd med å dra sørover, grepet av et «uimotståelig ønske» om å preke en gang til for sin menighet.»
findings.translation_quote: Selv om han var sterkt svekket av sykdommen, ble Lyte 4. september 1847, da han var i ferd med å dra sørover, grepet av et «ureistentlig ønske» om å preke en gang til for sin menighet.

findings.location:
...He passed away soon after the age of 55...

(paragraph about death, after hymn text)
findings.source_quote: He passed away soon after the age of 55, on November 20, 1847. His last words were “Joy! Peace!”
findings.suggested_fix: Render the original nuance “soon after the age of 55” rather than stating a single exact age. For example: «Han døde kort tid etter å ha fylt 55, den 20. november 1847. Hans siste ord var «Glede! Fred!»» or «Han døde kort tid etter å ha fylt 55 år, den 20. november 1847...»
findings.translation_quote: Han gikk bort kort tid etter, 55 år gammel, den 20. november 1847. Hans siste ord var «Glede! Fred!»
